settings.title: How long does shipping take?
settings.content: We prepare our pickles in fresh small batches. Orders are dispatched from our Virar kitchen within 1–2 business days. Delivery across India typically takes 3–7 business days depending on your location.

settings.title: Are there any artificial preservatives in your pickles?
settings.content: No, our pickles are 100% natural and homemade. We use only traditional methods (such as sun-drying) and natural preservatives like cold-pressed mustard oil, salt, and turmeric. Zero artificial chemicals or preservatives.

settings.title: Can I cancel or modify my order?
settings.content: Orders can be cancelled or modified within 12 hours of placement, or before dispatch. Once dispatched, we cannot cancel or recall packages. Please contact us via WhatsApp immediately if you need assistance.

settings.title: Do you accept returns or refunds?
settings.content: Due to the consumable nature of food items, we cannot accept returns once delivered. However, if your glass jar arrives damaged or leaking, send us a photo within 24 hours and we will ship a free replacement or issue a refund.
